title: Probability
summary: Probability from first principles to research level: events, random variables, distributions, limit theorems, random processes, inference and measure theory.

children.title: Foundations
children.summary: Sample spaces, the axioms, counting, conditioning, independence and Bayes' theorem.

children.title: Sample Spaces and Events
children.summary: Outcomes, events as sets, equally likely outcomes, and the probability of a union.

children.title: The Axioms of Probability
children.summary: Kolmogorov's axioms and their consequences: complements, the union bound, continuity, inclusion–exclusion.

children.title: Counting
children.summary: Permutations, combinations, multinomials, stars and bars, and the birthday problem.

children.title: Conditional Probability
children.summary: Conditioning, the multiplication rule, the law of total probability, and its traps.

children.title: Independence
children.summary: Independent events, pairwise versus mutual independence, and conditional independence.

children.title: Bayes' Theorem
children.summary: Inverting conditional probabilities, base rates, and the odds form.

children.title: Random Variables
children.summary: Discrete and continuous variables, distribution functions, expectation, variance and transformations.

children.title: Discrete Random Variables
children.summary: Probability mass functions, CDFs and indicator variables.

children.title: Continuous Random Variables
children.summary: Densities, CDFs, quantiles, and mixed distributions.

children.title: Expectation
children.summary: The mean, LOTUS, linearity, indicator tricks and the tail-sum formula.

children.title: Variance and Moments
children.summary: Variance, standard deviation, skewness, kurtosis and Bessel's correction.

children.title: Transformations
children.summary: The distribution of g(X), change of variables, and inverse-transform sampling.

children.title: Distributions
children.summary: The standard families and the mechanisms that produce them.

children.title: Bernoulli, Binomial and Geometric
children.summary: Independent trials: successes in n trials, and waiting for the first or r-th success.

children.title: The Poisson Distribution
children.summary: Rare events, the law of small numbers, superposition and thinning.

children.title: Exponential and Gamma
children.summary: Waiting times, memorylessness and competing exponentials.

children.title: The Normal Distribution
children.summary: The bell curve, standardisation, its tails and why it is everywhere.

children.title: Sampling Distributions
children.summary: Chi-square, Student's t, F and beta.

children.title: Several Random Variables
children.summary: Joint and conditional distributions, covariance, conditional expectation, sums and the multivariate normal.

children.title: Joint Distributions
children.summary: Joint PMFs and densities, marginals, conditionals and independence.

children.title: Covariance and Correlation
children.summary: Linear association, the variance of a sum, and covariance matrices.

children.title: Conditional Expectation
children.summary: E[Y | X], the laws of total expectation and variance, and best prediction.

children.title: Sums of Random Variables
children.summary: Convolution and families closed under addition.

children.title: The Multivariate Normal
children.summary: Gaussian vectors, Cholesky sampling, marginals and conditionals.

children.title: Tools
children.summary: Generating functions, inequalities and entropy.

children.title: Generating Functions
children.summary: PGFs, MGFs and characteristic functions.

children.title: Inequalities
children.summary: Markov, Chebyshev, Chernoff, Hoeffding, Jensen and Cauchy–Schwarz.

children.title: Entropy and Information
children.summary: Shannon entropy, KL divergence, mutual information and maximum entropy.

children.title: Limit Theorems
children.summary: Convergence, the law of large numbers, the central limit theorem and Monte Carlo.

children.title: Modes of Convergence
children.summary: Almost sure, in probability, in Lᵖ and in distribution; Borel–Cantelli.

children.title: The Law of Large Numbers
children.summary: Weak and strong laws, and what goes wrong without a mean.

children.title: The Central Limit Theorem
children.summary: Why sums look normal, how fast (Berry–Esseen), and when they do not.

children.title: Monte Carlo Methods
children.summary: Estimation by simulation, variance reduction and MCMC.

children.title: Random Processes
children.summary: Markov chains, random walks and martingales, Poisson processes and Brownian motion.

children.title: Markov Chains
children.summary: Transition matrices, classification, stationary distributions and convergence.

children.title: Random Walks and Martingales
children.summary: Gambler's ruin, fair games and optional stopping.

children.title: Poisson Processes
children.summary: Random arrivals, splitting and merging, and continuous-time Markov chains.

children.title: Brownian Motion
children.summary: The continuous limit of a random walk and its strange paths.

children.title: Inference
children.summary: From data back to the model: maximum likelihood and Bayesian inference.

children.title: Estimation and Maximum Likelihood
children.summary: Bias, variance, the likelihood, Fisher information and confidence intervals.

children.title: Bayesian Inference
children.summary: Priors, posteriors, conjugate families, credible intervals and prediction.

children.title: Measure-Theoretic Probability
children.summary: σ-algebras, measures, the Lebesgue integral, Radon–Nikodym and conditional expectation in general.
